title: Protector
description: A British Trail-class 4x4. Its Demo garage offers engine, suspension, tyre and tool-slot upgrades; the upgrade list includes prices for this vehicle.
imageAlt: Protector climbing an Algerian rocky slope in Over the Hill

sections.heading: Recorded vehicle identity
paragraphs: The June 13 gameplay menu labels this entry Protector, places it in Trail, and displays the United Kingdom flag. The flag is a catalog attribute, not a claim that a real manufacturer licensed this vehicle.

sections.heading: Availability in the recorded build
paragraphs: The entry is selected with an ownership check mark, and the recorded player drives it. That confirms use in this session without establishing its original unlock objective.

sections.heading: How to read this record
paragraphs: Horsepower, weight, a model year and complete unlock conditions are not inferred from the body shape. Compare only the catalog fields evidenced here; specific upgrade observations have their own build and vehicle context.

sections.heading: Protector upgrade observations
paragraphs: IGN shows an Engine Stage 2 purchase for 25 Pebbles at 5:21 and the two-slot inventory option for 25 Pebbles at 5:25. OverTake shows Suspension Level 2 for 20 Pebbles at 1:10 and Tires Stage 2 for 20 Pebbles at 12:35. These prices are tied to different recorded sessions, not a universal launch price list.

facts.label: Recorded availability
facts.value: Owned and equipped in this session

evidenceNote: Values are supported by the linked footage within its recorded pre-release build. Timestamps identify the menu or developer explanation; they do not establish final release balance.

seo.title: Protector | Over the Hill Wiki
seo.description: Protector is the owned Trail-class rig in this Demo session, with engine, suspension, tyre and equipment-slot upgrades in its garage menu.

upgrades: Engine Stage 2 (25 Pebbles in IGN footage)
Tool Slot: two-slot option (25 Pebbles in IGN footage)
Suspension Level 2 (20 Pebbles in OverTake footage)

playerNotes: Protector Demo upgrade prices: Engine Stage 2 — 25 Pebbles; two tool slots — 25 Pebbles; Suspension Level 2 — 20 Pebbles; Tires Stage 2 — 20 Pebbles. These come from different Demo sessions, so check your current shop prices.
